headline: Google opens Gemini 4 Carbon to broader developer, enterprise and research access
summary: On Nov. 10 Google announced broader access to Gemini 4 Carbon, following an Oct. 28 rollout initially limited to selected cyber defenders. The new post says paid developers and enterprises can use it through the Gemini API, Google AI Studio and business products; Google AI Ultra subscribers are receiving access in Antigravity, the Gemini app and Search. Google also expanded a research-access program. The post reports broad gains in coding, cybersecurity and scientific reasoning, but its benchmark and application claims remain provider-reported. This review did not verify a successful API call, access by region, or the linked Carbon-specific model card; no independent matched-harness reproduction was performed.
